framework_notes: The route is a complete static HTML document, with plain CSS and conventional script references. No component framework or build tool is demonstrated.
Reuse semantic HTML structures rather than generating React, Next.js, Vue, or Svelte components.
Existing page_intro, featured article, article cards, and image previews also provide reusable optional functionality.
The static_markdown adapter reports both index_shell_supported and detail_shell_supported as false. Adapter availability alone does not establish that it can safely patch this HTML shell.

details: Create a metadata-only article registry in a format supported by the static publishing workflow; JSON is a proposed alternative to the planned TypeScript module.
Seed it from the 35 grid entries and the featured entry, checking identities before deduplication.
Represent the ArticleRecord contract using an explicit schema. Preserve known titles, descriptions, dates, categories, images, featured status, and existing destinations.
Resolve contentPath, hasContent, authors, modification dates, editorial fields, and analytics identifiers from verified repository content rather than inventing values.
Preserve the featured story's legacy destination explicitly through routing or canonical-path metadata instead of deriving every URL from /stories/{slug}.
Identify or implement a supported deterministic publishing step that consumes registry metadata and emits the existing listing markup into HTML.
Document and connect that step to article publication so registry updates actually update the directory.
Keep the existing hero, containers, story-featured and story-card structures, stylesheet conventions, and inline SEO metadata.
Do not eagerly load article bodies to generate previews, and do not rely on browser execution of TypeScript or unprocessed frontmatter.
If no static generator is available, establish the publishing integration explicitly rather than leaving an unused registry file.
Apply the configured page size of 24 to registry-backed listing generation.
Define whether the separate featured entry counts toward the page size and prevent accidental duplication.
Emit ordinary HTML pagination links and appropriate canonical metadata for generated listing pages.
patch_plan.notes: Pagination is not a missing required slot, but the current 35-entry grid exceeds the supplied scale policy.

details: Check registry/output parity, unique identities, destination files, image paths, and canonical URLs.
Verify /stories redirects to /stories/ or otherwise resolves relative URLs correctly.
Confirm the generated page retains its heading, existing styling, article links, and metadata.
